2. What do rabbits eat? They eat grass. They have long teeth. They can eat a lot of grass.
3. Bees get food from flowers. They like yellow flowers. They like blue and purple flowers, too.

Animal Fun
The boys and girls go on a safari. They ride on a bus. They can see many animals. The crocodile is in the water. The elephant is on the grass. The giraffe is under the tree. There’s a mouse. The mouse is by the bus. The boys and girls are happy. A safari is fun!
What is the topic?
A safari — the boys and girls see many animals from a bus.
